prompt: I'm researching context engineering — pull up everything in the wiki on it.

assertions.text: References the [[context-engineering]] concept page as a wikilink
References at least two additional related pages (e.g. [[context-rot]], [[context-compaction]], [[just-in-time-context]], [[structured-note-taking]])
Cites at least one source page (e.g. [[effective-context-engineering-anthropic]] or [[context-engineering-guide-promptingguide]])
Returns a ranked/grouped result set rather than a single undifferentiated list
Uses Obsidian CLI queries (base:query on Glossary.base, tag, or search) for retrieval
